import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());

        String[] A_str = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");
        String[] B_str = br.readLine().trim().split(" ");

        int[] A_input = new int[3];
        int[] B_input = new int[3];

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            A_input[i] = Integer.parseInt(A_str[i]);
            B_input[i] = Integer.parseInt(B_str[i]);
        }

        int[] A_state = A_input.clone();
        int[] B_state = B_input.clone();

        int wins = computeWins(A_input, B_input);
        int losses = computeLosses(A_state, B_state);

        System.out.println((n - losses) + " " + wins);
    }

    private static int computeWins(int[] A_list, int[] B_list) {
        int total_wins = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            int target = (i + 1) % 3;
            int wins = Math.min(A_list[i], B_list[target]);
            A_list[i] -= wins;
            B_list[target] -= wins;
            total_wins += wins;
        }
        return total_wins;
    }

    private static int computeLosses(int[] A, int[] B) {
        int[][] moveOptions = { {0, 2}, {1, 0}, {2, 1}, {0, 0}, {1, 1}, {2, 2} };
        List<int[][]> permutations = generatePermutations(moveOptions);
        int max_loss_total = 0;

        for (int[][] perm : permutations) {
            int[] A_temp = A.clone();
            int[] B_temp = B.clone();
            int[] losses = {0, 0, 0};
            for (int[] move : perm) {
                int loss_amount = Math.min(A_temp[move[0]], B_temp[move[1]]);
                A_temp[move[0]] -= loss_amount;
                B_temp[move[1]] -= loss_amount;
                losses[move[0]] += loss_amount;
            }
            int total_loss = losses[0] + losses[1] + losses[2];
            if (total_loss > max_loss_total) {
                max_loss_total = total_loss;
            }
        }
        return max_loss_total;
    }

    private static List<int[][]> generatePermutations(int[][] moveOptions) {
        List<int[][]> perms = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(moveOptions, 0, perms);
        return perms;
    }

    private static void permute(int[][] arr, int index, List<int[][]> perms) {
        if (index == arr.length) {
            int[][] copy = new int[arr.length][2];
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                copy[i][0] = arr[i][0];
                copy[i][1] = arr[i][1];
            }
            perms.add(copy);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = index; i < arr.length; i++) {
            swap(arr, i, index);
            permute(arr, index + 1, perms);
            swap(arr, i, index);
        }
    }

    private static void swap(int[][] arr, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
    }
}
